name: weekly-digest
description: Every Monday at 8am — search arXiv for papers published in the past week on configured topics and produce a summary digest
prompt: Search arXiv for papers published in the last 7 days on the following topics: machine learning, LLM agents, retrieval-augmented generation. For each topic, find the top 3 most cited or relevant papers. Summarize each paper in 2-3 sentences covering the problem, method, and key result. Present the full digest grouped by topic.
